priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. The company believes Everson was granted full access to its books and records, except for materials related to pending litigation involving Toby Neugebauer, whom Everson represented on the Board.

general.title: Fmr. Fed Gov. Randy Kroszner: Warsh’s Statement Will Give Little Hint About Next Move
general.summary: Former Fed governor and University of Chicago Booth School of Business Economics Professor Randy Kroszner said the Fed is widely expected to leave rates unchanged, though he anticipates some dissenters may favor acting sooner because inflation has not eased as hoped. He expects most policymakers to see no urgency to move, while remaining alert to renewed inflation and inflation expectations. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Montage Intl. CEO: Future Bookings Are Higher Into 2027
general.summary: Alan Fuerstman, Founder and CEO of Montage International, said luxury travel demand has remained resilient despite higher costs and geopolitical uncertainty. He described the business as coming off a record year and said future bookings are up going into next year, with record holiday-period bookings at resorts across the U.S. and Mexico. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
